title: P0.74: Visible Response Capture Ladder for User Browser Sessions
description: Closes the safe middle path after IABV opens or focuses the user's normal browser. When the user says verification/login is done, IABV first attempts a governed visible-text capture from the focused browser surface before falling back to a blind isolated-profile retest.
reason: Opening or focusing the user's browser does not imply DOM/CDP access. The previous route could still re-test the isolated profile and miss the response already visible in the user's browser. The new ladder separates visible surface, semantic bridge, visible text capture, and unresolved manual pasteback.
next_action: Live-audit on Windows: ask IABV to open/focus the user's ChatGPT browser, complete any human verification, then type 'ya lo hice'. Expected: response_captured if visible text is captured; otherwise visible_capture_unreadable/target_missing with pasteback guidance, never success without captured text.
resume_hint: Implemented in ControlCenterViewModel. The route stores _last_visible_browser_surface for existing/default/governed windows, attempts visible clipboard capture only after explicit user confirmation, redacts emails/tokens/secrets, restores clipboard, and records visible_response_capture_* plus semantic_capture_ladder_result traces.

contracts: no cookies, tokens, credentials, browser storage, or hidden DOM are read
no success is declared without response_captured=true
without semantic bridge or useful visible text the result stays UNRESOLVED
unresolved: true background DOM capture for normal browser still requires CDP, extension, accessibility, OCR, or governed browser
